newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bank of France cuts key interest rate.
newsitem.headline: Bank of France cuts key interest rate.

text.p: The Bank of France trimmed a key interest rate on Thursday, lowering its intervention rate to 3.10 percent from 3.15 at a money market tender.
The move was announced after a meeting of the central bank's monetary policy council despite expectations by most economists that the recent rise in the dollar would lower the chances of a rate cut.
The intervention rate was last cut from 3.20 percent, on December 17.
The Bank left the five-to-10 day rate, which is considered less important at the moment, unchanged at 4.60 percent.
Most economists still believe France's sluggish economy and the stability of the French franc against other major currencies will allow further interest rate cuts in the months ahead.
